name: buy-me-a-car
description: Multi-skill plugin for car purchases (new + used + EV). Orchestrator runs the full 9-phase pipeline (research -> outreach -> negotiate -> close). 15 narrow sub-skills handle single tasks: dealer reply drafting, OTD math, state fee lookup, CPO eligibility, CARFAX/PDF review, inbox triage, close-day checklist, quote-evidence collection, trade-in valuation, EV federal credit, payment method, lease vs cash, PPI booking, dossier generation, and insurance shopping. Covers 22 US states + DC at fee-detail depth; 8 brand CPO programs; 5 buyer paths (cash / finance / lease / trade / EV).
